Now, I think younger folks might not appreciate just how big of a deal that was. I mean, we were in the midst of the Cold War, and the Soviets were tryin' to one-up us in every way they could. I remember watchin' the moon landing on TV with my family, and it was just... wow. It was like nothin' I'd ever seen before.
